caption:
Most leads don't go cold on their own.

They get killed by slow follow-up.

The Lead Response Audit finds the leak. Enter monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and typical response time.

It returns a response score and a lead-loss estimate, so you see where the money is bleeding before you spend another dollar on ads.

Industry benchmarks put average response time at over an hour for most service businesses, while leads contacted within 5 minutes close at meaningfully higher rates.

Run your numbers. Takes under a minute.

rationale: Single-offer promo cards still convert fastest for one clear ask, and the Lead Response Audit is next in this cycle's tool rotation after the Revenue Calculator.
